name: AI Recipe: News Collage
description: Claude researches the major U.S. news stories of a day, a week or a month (rotating) and writes the image prompt; the runner renders one cartoon-editorial image — a six-panel grid for a day or month, a single newsroom scene for a week — with short in-world captions and no likeness of any real person.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Image engine
parameters.help: The image IS this recipe's output, so it needs GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY (task secret or the clone's .env). auto uses the first one set.
